objects.name: Subject's Physical Health Deteriorates
objects.description:
Summary: Activity has the assessed impact of causing a decline in the subject's physical health without direct bodily injury.

Detail: This impact records physical health consequences which arise from the experience of being targeted rather than from any immediate physical injury.

A subject's physical health can deteriorate as a consequence of consuming misleading health information. Further, sustained harassment, surveillance, and threats produce documented physical effects, including sleep disruption, cardiovascular symptoms, appetite and weight change, and worsening of existing conditions.

Example

From mid-2021, claims circulated widely online that the antiparasitic drug ivermectin prevented or treated COVID-19, a use for which it is not authorised. [Outpatient dispensing reached more than 88,000 prescriptions in the week ending 13 August 2021,](https://archive.cdc.gov/emergency_cdc_gov/han/2021/han00449.asp) twenty-four times the pre-pandemic baseline, and [some people obtained veterinary formulations intended for large animals,](https://archive.cdc.gov/emergency_cdc_gov/han/2021/han00449.asp) which can be highly concentrated and cause overdoses when used by humans. [Calls to United States poison control centres for human ivermectin exposure had tripled against baseline by January 2021 and were running at five times baseline by July;](https://www.cnn.com/2021/08/26/health/ivermectin-covid-19-warning-injuries) emergency department and hospital visits rose correspondingly, and the CDC issued a health advisory on 26 August 2021 describing the resulting illness as severe. The Oregon Poison Center alone took [21 calls in August 2021 from people who had taken ivermectin for COVID-19.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34670041/) Six were hospitalised, four of them in intensive care, with reported effects including gastrointestinal distress, hypotension, confusion, ataxia, and seizures.
